source.probe: Word cached NunitoSans-Regular, 272.93 vs 261.5pt per probe string at 12pt against Helvetica

note:
Nunito Sans is an Office cloud font Word downloads and renders real (probe
2026-08-23). Its advances run 4.4% wider than Helvetica (272.93 vs 261.5pt
per probe string @12pt, measured from Word's cached NunitoSans-Regular), so
the size-adjusted alias keeps line wraps aligned with Word. A locally
installed Nunito still precedes this alias in the chain.
